micro.name: Micro Finance Scheme
micro.description: Ideal for small business and agricultural needs. Project cost up to ₹1.40 lakh, loan up to ₹1.25 lakh at 6.5% p.a. over 3 years.

aajeevika.name: Aajeevika Micro-Finance Yojana
aajeevika.description: Supports small livelihood projects up to ₹1.40 lakh. Loan up to ₹1.25 lakh at 15% p.a. repayable over 3 years with a 3-month moratorium.

udyam.name: Udyam Nidhi Yojana
udyam.description: For enterprise projects from ₹1.25 lakh up to ₹5 lakh. Loan up to ₹4.5 lakh at 13% p.a. (SC/ST) or 15% p.a. (others), repayable over 5 years.

term.name: Term Loan Scheme
term.description: Suitable for medium-scale business and agri-allied projects. Project cost ₹5L–₹50L, loan up to ₹45 lakh at 8% p.a. over 7 years.

edu.name: Educational Loan Scheme
edu.description: Designed for higher education financing. Loan up to ₹40 lakh (or 90% of course fee) at 6.5% p.a., repayable over up to 12 years with a moratorium for course duration plus 1 year.
